purpose: Seeds and synthetic parameters for the club and district fairness probes (B7). Synthetic geography only: districts are integer-grid stripes or id prefixes, not real places.
hypotheses_stated_before_results: H1 dense clubs control a larger share of districts than their share of ground; dispersed clubs of equal ground control none.
H2 raising minShare lowers the number of controlled districts and raises below_share; unclubbed walkers dilute control.
H3 a shade weight of 1/3 rewards shade-heavy clubs more than 1/4 does, by exactly the arithmetic ratio.
H4 an immediate D18 rule lets a hopper flip control every day; a delay alone does not stop hopping, a per-walker switch cooldown does.
H5 one double-membership row refuses district control for every district (documented hazard).
